alternatives.description: Keep bounded work packages and existing CI but rely on Git textual merge behavior for concurrent private-agent changes.
alternatives.projected_effect: Independent changes can merge cleanly even when they duplicate a responsibility or compose incorrectly.
alternatives.risk: Semantic collisions across different files, invariants, or FunctionContracts can remain silent.

alternatives.description: Require base/source-root/DesignEpoch-bound work intents and explicit integration evidence for concurrent semantic collisions.
alternatives.projected_effect: Concurrent changes become machine-comparable before integration while canonical and ActionGate authority boundaries remain unchanged.
alternatives.risk: Declared metadata can still be incomplete; legacy cross-file semantic overlap remains UNKNOWN outside available evidence.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING cannot machine-detect different-file semantic collisions or bind integration claims to the current source identity.
The guard adds contributor metadata and CI complexity and cannot infer undeclared semantics with certainty.

assumptions: Garden v15.5 remains immutable in canonical/current/.
Repository integration metadata is evidence and cannot mint authority or canonical status.
Legacy PRs without work intent cannot be assumed semantically independent merely because filenames differ.
reason.uncertainty: The guard depends on truthful and sufficiently complete semantic declarations; undeclared cross-file relationships remain unknown and GitHub branch protection is administratively separate.
counterexamples: Two agents edit different files but declare the same semantic domain; integration must require a receipt.
A PR declares a stale source root or base SHA; the guard must block it.
A legacy PR edits a file under a currently declared target directory; the guard must fail closed.
A clean textual merge must not by itself produce a COMPATIBLE semantic result.
reason.conclusion: Admit only a repository-level proposal-only integration provenance guard bound to the protected base identity; preserve ActionGate and HITL/canonical promotion as separate authority owners.

obligations.statement: Different-file overlap in semantic domain, invariant, or FunctionContract requires explicit integration evidence.
Current intent is bound to the actual PR base SHA and base canonical source root/DesignEpoch.
Changed paths not covered by the declared intent fail closed.
The integration guard cannot grant authority or promote canonical Garden source.

items.claim_scope: Requires a repo-wide conformance gate for material changes with explicit source identity and module bindings.
Exact protected-base predecessor for this repository hardening proposal.
Public Garden swarm already carries the shared AgentWorkIntent/IntegrationReceipt concept being specialized for the private build.
